entities.name: William Matthews Merrick
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William Matthews Merrick was a United States circuit judge of the United States Circuit Court of the District of Columbia, a United States representative from Maryland and an associate justice of the Supreme Court of the District of Columbia.
